extraction.name: LongVid
extraction.description: A large-scale long-video instruction-tuning dataset comprising 114,228 long videos and 3,444,849 question-answering pairs across five task types: video captioning, temporal grounding, event relation recognition, scene relation recognition, and video event counting. The paper reports 300,000 hours of videos and 2 billion words of textual annotations.
extraction.creator: Xinhao Li, Yi Wang, Jiashuo Yu, Xiangyu Zeng, Yuhan Zhu, Haian Huang, Jianfei Gao, Kunchang Li, Yinan He, Chenting Wang, Yu Qiao, Yali Wang, Limin Wang
extraction.citeAs: Xinhao Li, Yi Wang, Jiashuo Yu, Xiangyu Zeng, Yuhan Zhu, Haian Huang, Jianfei Gao, Kunchang Li, Yinan He, Chenting Wang, Yu Qiao, Yali Wang, and Limin Wang. VideoChat-Flash: Hierarchical Compression for Long-Context Video Modeling. arXiv:2501.00574v4, 13 July 2025.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: LongVid is curated from four existing open-source video datasets: Ego4D, HowTo100M, HD-VILA, and MiraData. The sources cover movies, egocentric videos, news, interviews, how-to videos, and other long-duration in-the-wild videos. Existing short-video captions and event-level annotations are used to construct timestamped event sequences and long-video question-answering pairs. The Ego4D portion uses 3,662 long videos. For HD-VILA, consecutive segments from the 10M training subset are selected when they can be reconstructed into videos longer than 60 seconds.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Videos originate from Ego4D, HowTo100M, HD-VILA, and MiraData. Caption and annotation sources include Ego4D-HCap for Ego4D, HowToInterlink7M/CosMo captions and HT-Step temporal instructional-step annotations for HowTo100M, Panda-70M captions for HD-VILA, and the original structured captions supplied by MiraData.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Consecutive short-video segments are regrouped into long-video sequences. Lower-level captions are concatenated to form dense captions: short captions are combined for medium-length Ego4D segments, and medium-level captions are combined for long segments. Event and background labels are arranged chronologically to create ground-truth relation sequences. Temporal-grounding answers use labels or captions with their corresponding timestamps; for Ego4D, other timestamps within the current medium-length segment are randomly selected as false options.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Existing high-quality short-video captions are filtered to identify consecutive segments that can be regrouped into long-video sequences. For HD-VILA, the filtering retains consecutive segments reconstructable into videos longer than 60 seconds. Captions, event labels, and segment timestamps are organized into timestamped event sequences and task-specific question-answering examples.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Annotations are constructed from existing captions, event-level labels, and timestamps rather than a newly described human-labeling process. Ego4D-HCap hierarchical captions are reused for captioning; concise short-video captions serve as event labels for event-order recognition and temporal grounding. HowTo100M uses HowToInterlink7M captions and HT-Step temporal annotations. For MiraData, Qwen-72b extracts event labels from main-object captions and background labels from background captions. HD-VILA uses Panda-70M captions, with event labels extracted in the same way as MiraData. Question-answering pairs are constructed for video captioning, temporal grounding, event relation recognition, scene relation recognition, and video event counting.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: Qwen-72b, an open-source large language model used to extract event and background labels from captions.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Long-video instruction tuning for multimodal large language models, supporting video captioning, temporal grounding, event relation recognition, scene relation recognition, and video event counting. LongVid is included in the joint short- and long-video instruction-tuning stage of VideoChat-Flash to improve understanding of diverse long-video scenarios.
